```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, repr.plot.width = 12, repr.plot.height = 8)
library(CCMHr)
library(gt)
library(kableExtra)
library(MASS)
library(mgcv)
library(patchwork)
library(refund)
library(scam)
library(splines)
library(tidyverse)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))
# theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 15),

#         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
#         axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
#         legend.position = "bottom",

# Define a custom color palette for the methods
my_colors <- c(
  "FTTM" = "#440154",
  # "mgcv LFCM" = "#414487",
  "LFCM" = "#2A788E",
  "loglogistic lfAFT" = "#7AD151",
  "lfAFT" = "#FDE725",
  "AFCM" = "#E03C8A",
  "afAFT" = "#B481BB"
)

folder_path <- "/Users/weijia/Research/FDA/Simulations/Output/20251022_additive"
# folder_path <- "/Users/weijia/Research/FDA/Simulations/Output/20250821_additive"
rda_files <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "\\.RDA$", full.names = TRUE)
all_results <- list()
for (i in 1:length(rda_files)) {
  all_results[[i]] <- loadRDa(rda_files[[i]])
}
```

```{r}
df_coef <- all_results[[2]][[1]]$coef
df_coef_long <- df_coef %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(true_coef, est_coef_aaft, est_coef_afcm),
    names_to  = "type",
    values_to = "coef"
  )

# make contour plots, faceted by type
ggplot(df_coef_long, aes(x = S, y = X, z = coef)) +
  geom_contour_filled() +
  facet_wrap(~ type, ncol = 1) +
  labs(
    x     = "S",
    y     = "X",
    #title = "True vs. Estimated F(x,s)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Average Out-of-Sample Brier Score Across Iterations
```{r}
all_info <- data.frame()
# Loop through all scenarios and iterations to extract 'info'
for (scenario in all_results) {
  for (iteration in scenario) {
    all_info <- rbind(all_info, iteration$info)
  }
}

table_Brier <- all_info %>%
  #filter(family != "loglogistic") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Brier_aaft", "Brier_afcm", "Brier_laft2", "Brier_lfcm"),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(est_model = case_when(str_detect(type, "aaft") ~ "afAFT",
                               str_detect(type, "afcm") ~ "AFCM",
                               str_detect(type, "laft2") ~ "lfAFT",
                               str_detect(type, "lfcm") ~ "LFCM"),
         est_model = factor(est_model, 
                            levels = c("afAFT", "AFCM", "lfAFT", "LFCM")),
         family = recode(family, "cox.ph" = "CoxPH"),
         log_value = log(value))

plot_additive_Brier <- table_Brier %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(nS), value, fill = est_model)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fatten = 1.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  facet_grid(family~n, labeller = labeller(n = label_both, family = label_value), scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "out-of-sample Brier score", fill = "Model"
       ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),  
    strip.background.y = element_blank()
    # strip.text = element_blank(), 
    # strip.background = element_blank()
  )
```
### Computation Time
```{r}
table_time <- all_info %>%
  group_by(beta_type, family, n, nS) %>%
  summarise(
    time_aaft = round(mean(time_aaft, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_afcm = round(mean(time_afcm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_laft = round(mean(time_laft, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    time_lfcm = round(mean(time_lfcm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    # time_fttm = round(mean(time_fttm, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


### MISE for Estimated Survival Functions
```{r}
all_surv <- data.frame() 

# Loop through all scenarios and iterations to extract 'coef'
for (scenario in all_results) {
  for (iteration in scenario) {
    # Extract data for the current iteration
    tmp_data <- data.frame(scenario = iteration$info$scenario,
                           iter = iteration$info$iter,
                           family = iteration$info$family,
                           n = iteration$info$n,
                           nS = iteration$info$nS,
                           beta_type = iteration$info$beta_type,
                           b = iteration$info$b,
                           mise_surv_aaft = mean(iteration$surv$se_surv_aaft),
                           mise_surv_afcm = mean(iteration$surv$se_surv_afcm),
                           mise_surv_laft = mean(iteration$surv$se_surv_laft),
                           mise_surv_laft2 = mean(iteration$surv$se_surv_laft2),
                           mise_surv_lfcm = mean(iteration$surv$se_surv_lfcm))

    # Append to all_coef
    all_surv <- rbind(all_surv, tmp_data)
  }
}

# boxplot
table_surv <- all_surv %>%
  filter(family != "loglogistic") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("mise_surv_aaft", "mise_surv_afcm", "mise_surv_laft2", "mise_surv_lfcm"),
               names_to = "type",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(est_model = case_when(str_detect(type, "aaft") ~ "afAFT",
                               str_detect(type, "afcm") ~ "AFCM",
                               str_detect(type, "laft2") ~ "lfAFT",
                               str_detect(type, "lfcm") ~ "LFCM"),
         est_model = factor(est_model, 
                            levels = c("afAFT", "AFCM", "lfAFT", "LFCM")),
         family = recode(family, "cox.ph" = "CoxPH"),
         log_value = log(value))

plot_additive_surv <- table_surv %>%
  ggplot(aes(factor(nS), log_value, fill = est_model)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE, fatten = 1.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_colors) +
  facet_grid(family~n, labeller = labeller(n = label_both, family = label_value), scales = "free") +
  labs(x = "", y = "log MISE of survival function", fill = "Model"
       ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x=element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    # strip.text = element_blank(), 
    # strip.background = element_blank()
  )

plot_additive <- plot_additive_Brier + plot_additive_surv +
  plot_layout(guides = 'collect', axes = "collect")

fig_dir <- "/Users/weijia/Research/FDA/Drafts"
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "fig_sim_additive.jpeg"), plot_additive, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 500)

```
